title: Wheat: yellow leaves troubleshooting
content: Yellowing wheat leaves can have several causes, including nutrient deficiency, water stress, or disease. Check the field and the undersides of leaves for rust-like yellow or orange powdery spots. Do not diagnose a crop disease from symptoms alone when the evidence is uncertain. For serious disease or treatment decisions, confirm with a qualified agricultural expert or the Disease Detection feature.

title: Sugarcane: sowing guidance
content: The suitable planting period for sugarcane depends on the region, variety, irrigation availability, and local agricultural recommendations. Farmers should use the sowing window recommended by their state agriculture department or local agricultural university rather than relying on one national date.

title: Wheat: fertilizer guidance
content: Urea requirements for wheat depend on soil fertility, variety, irrigation, previous crop, and the recommended nitrogen dose for the area. Avoid giving a single fertilizer quantity without the required local and field information. A soil test and local agriculture recommendation are preferable for deciding the dose and timing.

title: PM-KISAN overview
content: PM-KISAN is a Government of India farmer income-support scheme. Eligibility and registration requirements should be checked against the latest official PM-KISAN guidance and the farmer's land and beneficiary records. Farmers can use the official PM-KISAN portal or a Common Service Centre for applicable services.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana overview
content: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana is a crop insurance scheme. Coverage, notified crops, enrollment windows, premium details, and claim procedures can vary by notification and season. Farmers should verify the current season's notification and contact the relevant bank, insurer, agriculture department, or official PMFBY portal.

title: Kisan Credit Card overview
content: Kisan Credit Card provides agricultural credit facilities through participating financial institutions. Eligibility, limits, interest concessions, documentation, and terms depend on the applicable rules and lender. Farmers should check with their bank or the relevant official agriculture guidance for current terms.
